reviews.comment: Delaney led our section of this class under Dr. Tarvin, and connected with the class and showed genuine interest in us and our wellbeing. The research project was pretty difficult, but Delaney was detailed and super helpful as we worked our way through it. I would absolutely recommend taking a class with them.

This is for Comm 257. If you don't like to read, write, or critically think about your religious beliefs, this is not the class for you. If you are willing to ask questions, you will enjoy this class. Not every piece of material will be interesting. Group projects are important (know your tablemates). They are willing to compromise if needed.

reviews.comment: Literally such an amazing prof! Lectures are so engaging and in class activities are so fun. So kind and made class such a safe space. They provide a review before exams that was very helpful. Readings are sometimes boring but the lectures and discussions are always amazing. Literally so amazing highly recommend taking them for comm!

reviews.comment: Delaney is awesome and so relatable! They make lectures super interesting and encouraged everyone to keep an open mind and reflect on the material. I never studied and still did well because I was so focused and engaged during lecture. There are some readings, but they are not too long. Exams are free response, and group projects are actually fun.

Delany always had great lectures but still encouraged us to interact with each other to have a better understanding of complex ideas which was great. They are very knowledgeable and caring about the subjects too and it really shows. There are some readings, but they are pretty brief. If you keep an open mind, you will have an amazing experience!

If you want to learn about feminsim and gender roles then this is the class for you! You get to look at paintings of people with no clothes and analzye their gender. You also learn about oppression! But on a serious note, She is the worst professor I have ever had and don't waste your time nor money in this class unless you want to be indoctrinated

reviews.comment: Delaney was my TA and led recitation group. Hands down one of the most engaged, caring professors I've had. The class environment was so welcoming which made standing up and giving speeches much easier. I definitely grew as a public speaker and student from this course. Delaney genuinely cares to get to know all of the students. Highly recommend.
